So, I decided to create a simple script to get the name of the file and the name of the folder where the file is located.

First, I will use the basename function to get the name of the file.

Second, I will use the dirname function to get the name of the folder where the file is located.

Third, I will use the realpath function to get the absolute path of the file.

Finally, I will use the split function to get the name of the file and the name of the folder where the file is located.

Here is the code :

import os

def get_file_name_and_folder_name(file_path):
    file_name = os.path.basename(file_path)
    folder_name = os.path.dirname(file_path)
    file_path = os.path.realpath(file_path)
    file_name, folder_name = os.path.split(file_path)
    return file_name, folder_name
